consequence.statement: Deployments without an explicit cache backend configuration will automatically use the embedded cache instead of potentially running without one.

original.statement: Loki now automatically enables an embedded cache if no other cache backend is explicitly configured.

decision.reason: [ev-629a38c6f4b2] says only that Loki 3.0.0 now enables the embedded cache when no other cache is explicitly enabled. That is a changed default that keeps working. The evidence does not say that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind. The proposed statement matches the changelog wording, and the hedge "potentially running without one" does not overstate it.
